news.title: Three Sui mainnet halts in 48 hours traced to an upgrade bug by developers

news.title: Bitcoin extends slide as spot ETF outflows hit a record while Wall Street rips on AI
news.summary: U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs lost $2.97 billion across 10 trading days through Friday, the longest outflow streak on record. Oil's bounce on the stalled Iran deal added pressure even as global equities hit new highs on the Nvidia and SoftBank AI trade.
